basic_info.description: Welcome to 3229 and 3231 20th Street in the Vibrant Inner Mission District. This Duplex includes a 3 Bedroom 1 Bath Tenant Occupied Upper Unit and a 2 Bedroom 1 Bath Vacant Unit Offering Flexibility for both Investors and Owner Occupants. Directly across the street from John O'Connell Tech High School. Close Proximity to Flour and Water, Southern Pacific Brewing, and Mission Center Parks and Rec Center.  Additional amenities include one garage space, providing convenient parking and storage. This property is an excellent choice for those seeking a convenient and well-rounded lifestyle.
